title: Alliance Entertainment and JAKKS Pacific Team Up to Take Anime and VTuber Collectibles Further Across North America
summary: Exclusive partnership pairs JAKKS’ anime product expertise with Alliance’s fan reach and distribution strength PLANTATION, Fla. and SANTA MONICA, Calif., Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Alliance Entertainment Holding Corporation (NASDAQ: AENT), an entertainment commerce and collectibles platform generating more than $1 billion in annual revenue and serving more than 35,000 retail and e-commerce storefronts,...
body_markdown:
PLANTATION, Fla. and SANTA MONICA, Calif., Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Alliance Entertainment Holding Corporation (NASDAQ: AENT), an entertainment commerce and collectibles platform generating more than $1 billion in annual revenue and serving more than 35,000 retail and e-commerce storefronts, today announced an exclusive distribution partnership with JAKKS Pacific, Inc. (NASDAQ: JAKK), a leading global designer, manufacturer and marketer of toys and consumer products, for its anime and VTuber product lines. Under the agreement, Alliance will distribute JAKKS’ anime and VTuber products throughout North America, excluding mass retail.


The partnership brings together two companies that know this fandom. JAKKS brings the product: the design, development and manufacturing behind its anime division and the relationships that go with it. Alliance, one of the largest distributors of entertainment and collectibles in the industry, brings the reach: a presence at every major convention and fan event, deep ties to retailers and buyers, and a team of seasoned collectors who know how to connect with fans in an authentic way.


“We know anime, and we know what fans expect from the product,” said Ariana Berman, VP the Anime Division at JAKKS Pacific. “Alliance knows where those fans are, who the buyers are and how to show up for this community. Putting those two strengths together means more of our line in more of the right places, and we’re excited to build this next chapter with them.”


“What’s exciting about anime and VTuber collectibles is the connection fans have with the characters and creators they follow,” said Jeff Walker, Chief Executive Officer of Alliance Entertainment. “These are passionate communities that want products they can own, display and collect. We see a lot of opportunity to build on that enthusiasm together with JAKKS.”


“We see significant opportunity in the anime and VTuber space, and JAKKS is bringing compelling products and brands to the category,” said Tony Moyers, SVP Collectibles, Alliance Entertainment. “Alliance’s strength has always been connecting great products with the retailers, conventions, e-commerce channels, and collector communities that drive fandom. We’re excited to partner with JAKKS to expand distribution and help bring these offerings to fans across North America.”


The agreement covers distribution rights in North America, excluding mass retail.


For more information on JAKKS Pacific, visit[www.jakks.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=nO6Y6Ppv9YnZYGElua-0-atvCF68w0VHRq1_0dYxFxuOSAqKtnV1qbIAuT4TySHvg5fsQqpYqPWPSh8u2rbgoA==) . For more information on Alliance Entertainment, visit[www.aent.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=nJMWcAyFbUyQVdYdzL79aIdsX7nTz1SjSOLrqBh0oIb6LzgO7ZsuLhA1vFDIb0K9z2pUNSUL4_WjYYEjBTH4dQ==) .


**About Alliance Entertainment**


Alliance Entertainment (NASDAQ: AENT) is a premier distributor and fulfillment partner for the entertainment and pop culture collectibles industry. With more than 340,000 unique in-stock SKUs – including over 57,300 exclusive titles across compact discs, vinyl LPs, DVDs, Blu-rays, and video games – Alliance offers the largest selection of physical media in the market. Our vast catalog also includes licensed merchandise, toys, retro gaming products, and collectibles, serving over 35,000 retail locations and powering e-commerce fulfillment for leading retailers. Alliance also owns and operates proprietary collectibles brands, including Handmade by Robots™, a stylized vinyl figure line featuring licensed characters from leading entertainment franchises, and Alliance Authentic™, a premium platform for authentic, certified, and individually numbered entertainment collectibles. In addition, Alliance operates Endstate Authentic, a dedicated NFC-enabled authentication and digital product identity platform supporting authenticated collectibles, resale, and brand protection. Leveraging decades of operational expertise, exclusive sourcing relationships, and a capital-light, scalable infrastructure, Alliance connects fans and collectors to the products, franchises, and experiences they value across formats and generations. For more information visit[www.aent.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=nJMWcAyFbUyQVdYdzL79aDvVWXsdfC6FIjSMTRKp2K1vy5uc_DdP3Ns0ddf8aRzlwjlB_0MgayoH3R2uNiBSdg==) .


**About JAKKS Pacific, Inc.**


JAKKS Pacific, Inc. is a leading designer, manufacturer and marketer of toys and consumer products sold throughout the world, with its headquarters in Santa Monica, California. JAKKS Pacific’s popular proprietary brands include Disguise®, Fly Wheels®, Charming™, Kidtopia™, Moose Mountain®, Maui®, ReDo® Skateboard Co., Sky Ball®, and Xtreme Power Dozer® as well as a wide range of entertainment-inspired products featuring premier licensed properties. Through their products and charitable donations, JAKKS is helping to make a positive impact on the lives of children. Visit us at[www.jakks.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=nO6Y6Ppv9YnZYGElua-0-Si45Lt3ZR34-rhbX_UXvAwMaOEQwq-PYHzl7Fw2e2H8hhwydUWLPp6yNgzwl9daMQ==) and follow us on Instagram (@jakkspacific.toys), X (@jakkstoys), YouTube (@JAKKSPacific), Facebook (@jakkspacific.toys) and LinkedIn (JAKKS Pacific).
